name: soft-key-door-box
task: Take the key, then open the door. After that, try to pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the hard Existence(door_open) with the hard Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) covers the ordered key-then-door command and forces the key. The soft Existence(target_picked_up) and soft Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) match the 'try to' preference, with the order inside the preferred phrase kept soft. Moving the blocker is guaranteed by the environment constraints and is not stated in the task, so no clause is needed.

texts: Open the door (door_open must become true), the final step of the hard ordered sequence.
Take the key before opening the door: has_door_key must come before door_open.
Preferably pick up the box in the other room (target_picked_up).
After opening the door, preferably pick up the box: target_picked_up comes after door_open.
